archive.catalogue_description: Description My first map: Zombie cyclone Story: A nazi military camp was constructed in 1935 but back then it was only a house with 3 sheds were built. This was a secret base where only few people stayed and this was where the top generals had their meetings. There was also a castle which was there over 300 years. It has nearly destroyed, only 3 floors and 2 towers fully remained and was not used until 1939. In 1939 the place was extended by about 3 times the size(area) and a new apartment block was under construction behind the castle which could of allocated over 600 soldiers and more out hoses were built + the castle was being extended. The camp could of held over 1000 people when completed and there were also plans for more buildings. There was a train station built to transport troops which went directly to Berlin. It also had state of the Art training facilities and had out houses with ammunition. On 21st March 1941 there was a “zombies” out break. People fled on trains and people looted the place. Only buildings were left, a few guns and vending machines. Dempsey and the crew Teleported into the empty building when a Der Riese went wrong. Now the have to face the zombies on their own. Included in this map: Pack A Punch Turrets Auto turret Lots of open space and places for people who like camping Random box 4 perk machines No dog rounds Known Glitches: Sometimes zombies wont follow you from one or two windows.
